name: Prism Shin
description: Square the shoulders and set both fists at the same height so the pair can answer from either side.

name: Gallant Pinfall
description: Throw lead and rear jabs in a quick pair to shake the guard.

name: Bedrock Fist
description: Sink the hips into a low step that carries the fighter inside the opponent's reach.

name: Intrepid Grapple
description: Hook to the ribs and the head in a matched pair from a close stance.

name: Unwavering Shoulder
description: Channel an incoming blow along the forearm and past the shoulder like water through a ditch.

name: Palmcrown
description: Dip and bump the shoulder into the chest to unsettle the opponent's footing.

name: Hipcrown
description: Break a high guard by driving one elbow down and the other up against it.

name: Noble Sweep
description: Gather qi for two beats and release a pair of fists that stagger the opponent backward.

name: Harmonious Clinch
description: Run a four-blow set whose second pair is chosen by how the opponent answered the first.

name: Dantian Hip
description: Gather qi in both fists and strike the guard from two angles so the force passes through to the body.

name: Unrivaled Knee Verdict
description: Release the school's closing blow, a lead and rear fist landing at one instant on the same point of the chest.

name: Immovable Elbow
description: Crouch low with the hands open and forward, ready to seize.

name: Marrowfire Ulna
description: Hook the fingers round the wrist and pull it into the body.

name: Sweep Troth
description: Hold both arms of the opponent in a double grip and steer them.

name: Marrowfire Throw
description: Spiral down and in under the opponent's arm to take the back.

name: Entropy Knuckle
description: Roll across the shoulder with the opponent in hand and put them down.

name: Thrallclinch
description: Press the opponent onto the ground with a shoulder and a hooked arm.

name: Deluge Elbow
description: Release the lock and rise with a guard before the opponent can answer.

name: Crushing Heelbone
description: Seat the body in the opponent's hips and hold them still while the arms work.

name: Masterful Clinch
description: Drop onto the opponent's extended arm from above and bend the elbow against the joint.

name: Volition Ulna
description: Seize the arm and the neck together and press until the opponent's qi sinks and their power fades.

name: Commanding Shin
description: Fasten the grip on the arm and the shoulder point and seal the opponent's qi in a single held breath.

name: Marrowfire Hip
description: Spread the legs and sink the weight as if standing in the bed of the basin.

name: Authoritative Grapple
description: Take the collar and the elbow and bring the opponent's head down.

name: Thunderclap Heelbone
description: Dive under the arms for the knees and drive the opponent to the floor.

name: Shoulder Troth
description: Flow the opponent over the hip along the line of their own pull.

name: Thrallelbow
description: Settle the weight across the chest as a river settles in a basin.

name: Dantian Knee
description: Hook one leg then the other from the ground to unseat a standing opponent.

name: Ulnapledge
description: Pull with one arm as the opposite leg sweeps and the opponent falls between.

name: Dantian Fist
description: Roll from a kneeling position out of a hold and onto the feet.

name: Millstone Sweep
description: Press with the full weight through the hold until the opponent's qi cannot gather.

name: Sigil Throw
description: Hold the pin and press the dantian point to still the qi until the opponent yields.

name: Despotic Entropy Hip
description: Gather qi in the hips and throw the opponent in one great spill of strength.

name: Inviolate Palm
description: Hold both palms before the face so that a blow slides off them.

name: Marrowfire Clinch
description: Strike with the left palm and follow at once with the right.

name: Venerable Knuckle
description: Slide the palm along the arm to turn the attack against the bank.

name: Squallshin
description: Step off to the side and come in on a different line.

name: Squallhip
description: Strike from above the guard with a palm that falls like a hawk.

name: Sigilknee
description: Pinch the wrist with one palm and strike with the other.

name: Matchless Knee
description: Slide the first palm back as the second goes forward in a rowing pair.

name: Majestic Chokehold
description: Gather qi in both palms and push them forward in a surge that sweeps the opponent back.

name: Tenetclinch
description: Throw a run of palms from two sides that all converge on a single point.

name: Fisttriumph
description: Join qi from both palms into one stream and drive it through the guard into the chest.

name: Pulsarthrow
description: Cross the distance in a flash of qi and land both palms on the opponent's body.

name: Unrivaled Palm
description: Release the school's closing palm in which two streams of qi meet in the body at the point of the blow.

name: Knuckle Troth
description: Hold the guard on both tracks at once, the fist ready to strike and the hand ready to seize.

name: Shoulder Decree
description: Throw a quick jab along the track of the fist to open the way.

name: Clinchpledge
description: Seize the wrist along the grip track and draw the opponent in.

name: Fistvoyage
description: Step in a way that changes the fight from one track to the other.

name: Vigor Palm
description: Drive the elbow down on a held arm as it is pulled into reach.

name: Fistseal
description: Turn the hip and throw the opponent over it as their arm is drawn out.

name: Sphere Elbow
description: Hold the opponent with one hand and strike with the other, qi flowing between the two.

name: Symphonic Shin
description: Move from jab to seizure to throw to strike as one unbroken line.

name: Pulsar Chokehold
description: Gather qi in the arm and drive a chop through the guard and into the collarbone.

name: Gallant Sphere Grapple
description: Release the school's closing blow in which the grip pulls the opponent onto the fist and the fist lands with the whole pull.

name: Heelbone Covenant
description: Raise the arms open and wide so that the whole body is covered.

name: Vigorknee
description: Sink to a low stance and move without rising to keep the weight at the floor.

name: Elbowedict
description: Rise from the low stance with the fist leading in a vertical line.

name: Deluge Shoulder
description: Sweep a limb aside with a long smooth motion of the forearm.

name: Steelsweep
description: Drop a palm onto the head from the highest point of the guard.

name: Kernel Ulna
description: Bind the arm and throw the opponent into the basin of the floor.

name: Vigorfist
description: Strike from above and below at once and let the qi meet in the body.

name: Pinfall Crown
description: Run strike, throw, strike, pin with the Core driving each in turn.

name: Sainted Fist
description: Take a blow into the Core and send it back out along the arm in a single movement.

name: Sovereign Knuckle Banner
description: Gather qi in the Core and release a strike that passes through every guard.

name: Statute Ulna
description: Plant the feet along one line and keep the shoulders level to face the opponent squarely.

name: Bedrock Chokehold
description: Flick the lead fist out quick and light like the first breath of a rising wind.

name: Squallknee
description: Step forward on the bearing without lifting the rear foot more than a hand's breadth.

name: Haemalsweep
description: Drive the rear fist across from the hip with the stride behind it.

name: Elbow Seal
description: Turn an incoming blow aside with the forearm and keep the bearing.

name: Palmdecree
description: Slip the head off the line and drive a fist to the ribs.

name: Majestic Grapple
description: Hold the stance and throw the elbow when the opponent comes within it.

name: Triumphant Chokehold
description: Gather qi along the arm for two beats and release it in a punch that staggers the opponent.

name: Seasonfist
description: Throw a run of strikes along one bearing, each following the one before without a pause.

name: Triumphant Pinfall
description: Gather qi and send the fist along the bearing through the guard and into the body.

name: Gallant Marrowfire Fist
description: Release the school's closing blow in which the whole body, the breath and the oath fall into a single fist.

name: Marrowfire Shin
description: Set the feet wide on a bearing with the knees bent and the back straight.

name: Binding Throw
description: Take a firm grip on the sleeve and collar along the bearing.

name: Pealthrow
description: Pull the opponent forward onto the open ground before them.

name: Entropy Clinch
description: Lean the whole body onto the opponent and drop them.

name: Commanding Palm
description: Sweep the foot from beneath the opponent as their weight shifts.

name: Hip Grace
description: Roll away along the bearing and rise with the guard up.

name: Sigil Shoulder
description: Settle on the opponent and hold them along the bearing.

name: Peal Ulna
description: Brace against the push and turn the hips to be free of the hold.

name: Gloomhip
description: Press into the opponent with a weight that grows steadily until their qi cannot rise.

name: Sigilhip
description: Hold the arm in a lock and press the shoulder point to seal the qi in the limb.

name: Pealclinch
description: Gather qi in the hips and throw the opponent so that their whole stance collapses along the bearing.

name: Statute Heelbone
description: Hold both open hands before the chest and keep them still until the blow comes.

name: Thunderclap Chokehold
description: Slip the head and strike with the open palm at the opponent's chest.

name: Gliding Throw
description: Step in with a palm leading to close the gap in a single move.

name: Heelbone Troth
description: Turn the blow aside with the flat of the hand in a crosswind sweep.

name: Shinverdict
description: Lift the palm sharply up under the chin.

name: Dantian Pinfall
description: Press the palm firmly onto the chest along the bearing.

name: Thrall Fist
description: Seize the wrist and turn it against the thumb to open the opponent's guard.

name: Unrivaled Pinfall
description: Chop with the edge of the palm to the neck.

name: Marrowfire Palm
description: Strike, parry, press and chop in one flowing run of the open hand.

name: Pulsarsweep
description: Gather qi in the palm and release it in a pulse that passes through the guard into the chest.

name: Venerable Shin
description: Meet the blow with an open palm and send its force along the same line into the attacker.

name: Squall Knuckle
description: Release the school's closing blow in which the palm lands as the whole gale on one point of the chest.

name: Immaculate Hip
description: Plant the feet on the open ground with a low centre and level shoulders.

name: Despotic Elbow
description: Take the collar and drive the elbow in against the neck.

name: Ethereal Elbow
description: Take a long step to the side and come in on the opponent's flank.

name: Commanding Throw
description: Turn the hip under the opponent along the bearing and throw.

name: Deluge Knee
description: Slip out of a hold and take a hold of your own.

name: Ruling Palm
description: Reap the leg and drop the opponent on the open ground.

name: Imperious Shin
description: Pin the opponent down and hold them until they yield.

name: Deluge Heelbone
description: Roll through a throw and come up with the opponent's back exposed.

name: Tenethip
description: Chain grip, pull, throw and pin in a single run across open ground.

name: Sigilelbow
description: Lock the arm and press the qi point so the opponent cannot gather their strength.

name: Marrowfire Shoulder
description: Throw the opponent in the school's closing throw, with qi in the hips carrying them far across the open ground.

name: Penumbra Ulna
description: Hold the guard on a steady bearing that does not move however hard the wind blows.

name: Inferno Sweep
description: Throw a straight punch along the bearing with a breath behind it.

name: Sweepboon
description: Slip the foot sideways off the line of attack.

name: Pall Knee
description: Turn the attack aside along the bearing and hold the hand ready.

name: Vigor Knuckle
description: Curve the fist around the guard into the opponent's side.

name: Venom Hip
description: Use the opponent's weight to carry them over the hip.

name: Ironhold Knee
description: Hold the opponent down along the bearing until they yield.

name: Penumbra Clinch
description: Extend the qi field along the arm and strike through the field's reach.

name: Knuckle Crown
description: Run strike, parry, throw and pin as one connected line inside the qi field.

name: Eclipse Palm
description: Take a blow into the qi field and send it back out along the bearing.

name: Thunderclap Grapple
description: Release the school's closing blow, a fist that carries the wind's whole force along one bearing through any guard.

name: Ironclad Ulna
description: Align feet, hips, shoulders and fists on one line and breathe from the belly.

name: Kernel Sweep
description: Drive the lead fist from the hip so the whole body goes into it.

name: Soundless Sweep
description: Slide the foot along the bearing with the weight low and even.

name: Triumphant Grapple
description: Pivot on the foot and throw the elbow with the hips behind it.

name: Stately Hip
description: Turn a blow aside with the shoulder and arm together.

name: Steelulna
description: Drive the knee into the body at close range with the oath stance intact.

name: Clinchbanner
description: Time the breath to the blow so the qi follows the fist at the instant of contact.

name: Throw Triumph
description: Run fist, elbow, knee and shoulder in a single motion of the whole body.

name: Undefiled Shoulder
description: Take the blow into the Core and send it out along the bearing.

name: Fearless Quenched Shin
description: Release the school's closing blow, in which the Core, the breath and the whole body fall into one strike that nothing turns aside.
